background: green-screen intermediate for native ImageGen alpha extraction
prompt:
Create a NEW 24-frame full-body animation sprite sheet of the EXACT character in the SINGLE CHARACTER reference. The blue border and numeral are not part of the design. Preserve her original delicate face/eye shapes, compact CHIBI head-body ratio, SHORT legs, silver-white curls, lavender shading, both segmented horns, pointed ears, screen-right white flower hair ornament, small violet bat wings, curled white scaled tail, ornate white off-shoulder dress with original silver central clasp/filigree, waist flower, ribbons, layered long side ruffles with open short front, leg strap and small white shoes. COPY the design; do not redesign or simplify it. No thick black corset bars, no costume change, no larger eyes/head/tail, no longer torso/legs.
Format: SIX equal columns x FOUR equal rows = EXACTLY24 equally sized cells, landscape4:3, reading row-major. Every character is fully frontal, orthographic, at identical scale. Figure is only75% of cellheight; keep clear10% margin ABOVE the highest ahoge/horn and10% BELOW shoes. Same centered torso and shoe baseline in all cells. Full wings, fingers, skirt and tail inside each cell. No cell touching or overlap. No numbers, text, lines, shadows, floor or props.
Background is completely uniform PURE GREEN RGB0,255,0 (also all tiny gaps between hair, limbs and garment), with no gradient or other marks. No green on the character, clean colored outlines without fringe. Green will be removed separately.
Motion is a gentle THINKING LOOP: stand upright, feet planted. Her RIGHT hand (on SCREEN LEFT) slowly raises from the original low relaxed position to the chin while the other hand makes a tiny up/down sway. Head tilts just4degrees toward raised hand; hair/sleeve/tail very subtly follow. Exactly2 anatomically connected arms and hands.
FRAMES1-6 are six distinct inbetweens from hand low to hand at chin:1 original low relaxed pose;2 hand up10%;3 up25%;4 up45%;5 up65%;6 up85%. Bend elbow naturally, not shoulder teleport.
7 hand softly touches chin;8 settles;
9 BOTH eyes half close;10 BOTH eyes completely close;11 BOTH eyes half open;12 BOTH eyes fully open. Never a wink or a different facial expression.
13-16 quiet thinking hold with tiny breathing and loose other-hand sway.
17-24 lower SAME hand in very small continuous steps and straighten head:17 at95%;18 at85%;19 at65%;20 at45%;21 at25%;22 at10%;23 at2%;24 original neutral. Frame24→1 seamless.
No head/body/costume/ornament size changes between frames. Every next painting is the same figure with only tiny necessary pose changes, not24 redesigned versions. Stable clothing, hair locks, scales, face and illumination in all24 frames.
